{ "rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is strongly positive to correct mean reversion lag",
    "Increase forecast magnitude when sentiment flips from negative to positive",
    "Smooth forecast volatility by 15-20% to correct overshooting",
    "Pull forecasts toward mean when deviating more than 5% from recent range",
    "Boost low forecasts when adjacent days have positive sentiment",
    "Reduce forecast momentum when price change rate is accelerating",
    "Cap individual day forecast changes at 1.5x previous day's actual change"
] }
